scripts.setup: npm ci && npm run sync && npm run pi:setup && npm run ai:setup
scripts.sync: npm ci --prefix apps/web && npm ci --prefix apps/extension && npm ci --prefix apps/pi-service && uv sync --directory apps/backend --dev
scripts.pi:setup: npm ci --prefix third_party/pi --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix third_party/pi run build:offline
scripts.check:ai: uv run --directory apps/backend python ../../scripts/quality/check_ai_links.py && uv run --directory apps/backend python ../../scripts/quality/check_skills.py && npm run check:docs && npm run check:contracts
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory apps/backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:init: uv run --directory apps/backend python ../../scripts/db/init_mysql.py && uv run --directory apps/backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:extension && npm run build:backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:extension
scripts.test: npm run test:dev-env && npm run test:web && npm run test:extension && npm run test:miniprogram && npm run test:backend
scripts.check:pi: npm --prefix third_party/pi run check:model-data && npm --prefix third_party/pi run build:offline && npm --prefix apps/pi-service run check && npm run test:pi
scripts.check:app: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run check:pi
scripts.check: npm run check:ai && npm run check:app
